doc.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

chapter: The Bay Area scene and tastes
title: Pop music tastes
summary: James Brown, Aretha and James Taylor.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: What about, do your tastes go into — who do you like in the pop world, anyone in particular?
I don’t find myself in that arena very often. God. Who have I heard that I like? There must be somebody out there. I really can’t think of anybody.
I know I don’t listen to it that much myself.

If you’re talking about other styles of music, James Brown of course and Aretha, and James Taylor I like. I really dig James Taylor. Every now and then I’ll see him on something and I think I like this guy.
Yeah. And he always has a great band too.
Yeah. But it’s just kind of folksy, but it’s not. It’s more. And I don’t know just out of the blue, stuff that I think is cool.
